About SENZ MACHINERY

Precision separation built for continuous industry.

Senz Heavy Machinery Separation Technology Co., Ltd. has focused on decanter centrifuges, dewatering systems, disc separators, and oil-water separation packages since 1989. Buyers rely on us for heavy-duty engineering, clear documentation, and export-ready execution across mining, oil, and wastewater projects.

Capability Stack

Manufacturing Depth

Integrated fabrication, machining, balancing, and assembly for high-load rotating equipment.

Application Engineering

Process matching for sludge, slurry, oil-water, and solid-liquid separation duties.

Customization Control

Configured skids, spare parts, and layout adaptations for plant standards and duty cycles.

Global Delivery Support

Export packing, technical files, remote commissioning coordination, and after-sales response.

Documentation & Proof
